Questions

Which WageGrid metro has the highest HVAC technicians annual median?

Seattle-Tacoma-Bellevue, WA has the highest published OEWS May 2025 annual median for Heating, Air Conditioning, and Refrigeration Mechanics and Installers ($80,100). Among metros with a published median: Seattle $80,100, Chicago $77,960, Austin $60,820. WageGrid does not rank suppressed cells or invent a missing wage.

Which WageGrid metro employs the most HVAC technicians?

Chicago-Naperville-Elgin, IL-IN has the highest published OEWS May 2025 employment for Heating, Air Conditioning, and Refrigeration Mechanics and Installers (7,210 wage-and-salary workers). Published employment: Chicago 7,210, Seattle 3,940, Austin 3,140. Self-employed workers are excluded.

Where are HVAC technicians most concentrated relative to the national mix?

Austin has the highest published location quotient (0.92). Published LQs: Austin 0.92, Seattle 0.72, Chicago 0.61.

What is the hourly median for HVAC technicians in each metro?

OEWS May 2025 hourly medians: Austin $29.24; Chicago $37.48; Seattle $38.51. Blank means BLS withheld the estimate.

Does this comparison include self-employed workers?

No. OEWS covers wage-and-salary workers and excludes the self-employed. WageGrid does not add a self-employment estimate.

U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics, Occupational Employment and Wage Statistics, May 2025. WageGrid is not affiliated with BLS. Blank cells are BLS suppressions, not estimates.
